provenance_amendment.issue: Mission pinned Figshare 7387130 v6, but Figshare no longer serves versions 1-7; /versions returns only [8], and /versions/6 returns HTTP 404. v6 cannot be retrieved or hash-verified.
provenance_amendment.resolution: Pin the only live, retrievable release: v8. v8 is a LATER curated release that supersedes v6.
provenance_amendment.why_scientifically_acceptable: The reason the mission selected a post-correction version was the corrected category_index/image_index metadata. v8 (2026-06-03) is strictly later than v6 and therefore contains those corrections (and any further curation). Selecting the latest supersession satisfies -- indeed exceeds -- the correctness requirement that motivated the v6 selection.
provenance_amendment.reproducibility: Reproducibility is preserved by pinning v8 file IDs + supplied_md5 (below) and computing SHA-256 on download; the empirical Phase 1 data-contract audit will re-verify all trial invariants and the 50/50 category correspondence against the selected files before any reliability outcome is inspected.
provenance_amendment.cache_rule_honored: No older cached GOD dataset is reused; the ONLY accepted files are those matching the v8 IDs + MD5 recorded here.
